claims.assertion: Mari defines a higher self as a more evolved version of a person and says non-linear time may let it coexist with its incarnated self.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says the incarnated person may not share that expanded identity perspective.

claims.assertion: Mari argues that a higher self should not use an incarnated person’s suffering to expand its own consciousness.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes the light-being’s perspective from the embodied person’s.
